thesis: Solana institutional delta-neutral protocol (USX stablecoin) broke out to new ATH at 12:20Z 6-27 on the back of Binance trading event + Upbit (6-1) / CoinEx (6-3) listings; v/m 1.94 = real turnover, not just price. Wrong if it gives back the breakout zone — failed breakouts on parabolic +130% 7d moves typically retrace -25-40% to the prior range.
